Solanaceae (solanum, nightshade, or potato family) » Nicandra physalodes nee-KAN-druh -- named for Nikander of Colophon, 2nd century Greek fy-sal-OY-deez -- meaning, like a bladder commonly known as :

Introduced, warm-season, annual herb. Stems are hollow, branched and 0.5-2 m tall (occasionally to 4 m). Leaves are narrow to broad, 4-15cm long and hairless; may be irregularly toothed or lobed. Blue
